reference_audio.note: Optional: omit to use a built-in preset (`voice`, or the loaded language's default).  Zero-shot cloning needs the gated model weights; clips are truncated to 30 s.  The engine does not use a transcript of the clip, so there is no `reference_text`.

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample (roughly 5--15 s of clean speech works well) as a base64 string, cloned zero-shot.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...).  The engine uses at most the first 30 s.  Omit to use `voice` or the default preset voice.  Mutually exclusive with `voice`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en'.  Accepted for API consistency but not forwarded: a Pocket TTS server speaks the single language of its loaded model ('en' here), whatever is requested.  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.  The voice itself is fixed by the clip or preset; the seed only varies delivery, so the same seed gives the same audio.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Built-in preset voice name.  Omit (together with `audio_base64`) to use the loaded language's default voice.  Presets are tied to the language of their recordings; the engine rejects a preset that does not match the loaded model.  Mutually exclusive with `audio_base64`.
